community: Remote & backcountry, Columbia Shuswap Regional District

description.value: McMurdo Cabin is a rustic backcountry wilderness hut in the Northern Purcell Mountains, one of five remote huts maintained by the Columbia Valley Hut Society, a non-profit founded in 1983. The area around the cabin offers wildlife viewing, high country travel in summer, and ski touring in winter. Access requires backcountry travel with variable hiking distances depending on route-finding and seasonal road conditions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms McMurdo Cabin is a remote backcountry wilderness hut operated by the Columbia Valley Hut Society in the Northern Purcell Mountains, described as 'rustic' and aimed at 'self-propelled, non-motorized recreationalists' accessed by hiking or skiing. No bike-specific amenities, staff, or facilities are mentioned anywhere on the site. There is no on-site staffing — the society is volunteer-run and bookings are made online — making all staff-related and most amenity criteria unanswerable.
